scenario.title: 電梯裡、等公車時的天氣話題
scenario.context: 天氣是全世界最安全的閒聊題材：在電梯、等車、會議開始前都能用。台灣的天氣尤其好聊：悶熱、午後雷陣雨、颱風假。這個單元的主角是虛主詞 It。

lines.speaker: Coworker
lines.en: Wow, it's so muggy today.
lines.zh: 哇，今天好悶。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know. I was sweating the second I walked out of the station.
lines.zh: 對啊，我一走出車站就開始流汗。

lines.speaker: Coworker
lines.en: It's supposed to rain this afternoon, too.
lines.zh: 而且聽說下午會下雨。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Of course it is. It's Taipei in June.
lines.zh: 當然會啊，六月的台北嘛。

lines.speaker: Coworker
lines.en: Did you bring an umbrella?
lines.zh: 你有帶傘嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Always. I keep one in my bag all year round.
lines.zh: 一定有，我一年四季包包裡都放一把。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: How do you guys live in this? It's thirty-five degrees!
lines.zh: 你們怎麼受得了？三十五度欸！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, it's a scorcher even for us. Today's extra bad.
lines.zh: 說真的，這對我們來說也超熱，今天特別誇張。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Back home it's probably snowing right now.
lines.zh: 我家那邊現在應該在下雪吧。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I'd take snow over this. Wait, is it raining?
lines.zh: 我寧願下雪。等等，是在下雨嗎？

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: Wow, it's pouring. It was sunny five minutes ago!
lines.zh: 哇，傾盆大雨。五分鐘前還大太陽欸！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Welcome to summer afternoons in Taiwan. It'll stop in half an hour.
lines.zh: 歡迎來到台灣的夏天午後。半小時後就會停了。

lines.speaker: Ryan
lines.en: How far is it to the MRT? Should we just run?
lines.zh: 到捷運站多遠？我們要用跑的嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: It's only about five minutes, but let's wait it out in this café.
lines.zh: 只要五分鐘左右，但我們先在這間咖啡店等雨停吧。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Did you hear? It's a typhoon day tomorrow. No work!
lines.zh: 你有聽說嗎？明天放颱風假，不用上班！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Finally! Is it going to be a big one?
lines.zh: 終於！這個颱風會很大嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: They say it's going to be really windy tonight.
lines.zh: 聽說今晚風會很大。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Better stock up on snacks and instant noodles.
lines.zh: 那最好先囤點零食和泡麵。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Already did. It's going to be a movie marathon day.
lines.zh: 已經囤了。明天就是電影馬拉松日。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Stay safe, and don't go outside!
lines.zh: 注意安全，別出門！

patterns.en: It's so hot today, isn't it?
patterns.note: 附加問句讓對方好接話（第 29 單元會詳細講）
be supposed to = 預計、據說會

patterns.en: It looks like it's going to rain.

patterns.zh: 已經下一整個禮拜的雨了。

patterns.en: It's getting late. I should go.
I keep an umbrella in my bag all year round.
patterns.zh: 我一年四季都放一把傘在包包裡。

chinglish.why: 中文「今天很熱」主詞是今天。英文雖然 Today is hot 也不算錯，但母語者習慣用 It 當主詞講天氣。
「外面在下雨」直翻會把 outside 當主詞，但英文下雨的主詞一定是 It。

chinglish.wrong: The weather is very hot and wet.
chinglish.right: It's hot and humid. / It's muggy.
chinglish.why: wet 是「濕的」，指東西被弄濕。空氣潮濕、悶熱要說 humid 或 muggy。
中文「明天有颱風」的「有」直翻成 have 是常見錯誤。存在要用 There is（第 11 單元會詳細講）。

grammar.title: 虛主詞 It（天氣、時間、距離）
grammar.oneLiner: 英文句子一定要有主詞，講天氣、時間、距離時，沒有真正的主詞就用 It 頂上去。
whenToUse: 天氣：It's raining. / It's cold. / It's getting windy.
時間、日期：It's 3 o'clock. / It's Friday! / It's getting late.
距離：It's about 2 kilometers. / It's a five-minute walk.
整體情況：It's so crowded here. / It's quiet today.
這個 It 沒有意思、不需要翻譯，只是文法上的主詞。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文常常沒有主詞：「下雨了」「好熱」「三點了」「很遠」都能單獨成句。英文每個句子都要有主詞，所以台灣人會不自覺地把「今天」「外面」「天氣」塞進主詞位置（Outside is raining），或直接漏掉（Is raining）。記住：講天氣時間距離，先說 It。

examples.correct: It's really humid in Taipei in the summer.
examples.note: 用 It 當主詞，形容悶熱用 humid。

examples.correct: How far is it to the station?
examples.incorrect: How far to the station is?

examples.correct: It's supposed to be sunny tomorrow.

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
quiz.explanation: 英文一定要有主詞，天氣用 It。

quiz.question: ___ about a fifteen-minute walk from here.
Which word describes hot and wet air?
quiz.explanation: 空氣潮濕悶熱用 humid（或 muggy）。

quiz.question: It's getting ___. We should head home.
quiz.explanation: It's getting late / dark = 時間晚了／天黑了。

slang.usage: 字面是「結冰」，但日常用來誇張地說很冷，不一定真的零度以下。也可以說 I'm freezing.

risk.note: 任何場合都能用。辦公室冷氣太強時很好用。

examples.en: Can we turn the AC down? It's freezing in here.
examples.zh: 冷氣可以調弱一點嗎？這裡冷死了。

examples.en: I'm freezing. I should've brought a jacket.
examples.zh: 我好冷，早知道就帶外套。

slang.usage: 形容熱到像被烤的一天：Today's a scorcher.

risk.note: 英式新聞和閒聊特別愛用，美國人也懂。

examples.en: It's going to be a scorcher today. Drink lots of water.
Yesterday was a real scorcher. It hit 37 degrees.

slang.usage: 雨下很大時說，也可以說 It's pouring down / pouring rain。

examples.en: It's pouring outside. Let's get a taxi.
examples.zh: 外面下超大，叫計程車吧。

examples.en: I got caught in the pouring rain on my way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上被大雨困住了。

slang.usage: 又熱又潮濕、空氣黏在身上的感覺，台灣夏天的完美形容詞。

risk.note: 口語常用，比 humid 更有「不舒服」的感覺。

examples.en: It's so muggy, my hair is a mess.
Taiwan summers are hot and muggy.

review.question: I don't have ___ time. Can we make it quick?
review.explanation: 複習第 6 單元：time 不可數，用 much。

review.question: 1,500 for a plain T-shirt? What a ___-off.
review.explanation: 複習第 6 單元：rip-off = 坑人。

review.question: Does this soup have ___ pork in it?
review.explanation: 複習第 5 單元：真的在問有沒有，用 any。

review.question: Let's meet ___ the entrance of the museum.
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：會面點用 at。

review.question: It's so hot and ___ today. My shirt is sticking to me.
